pages.title: Amethyst Singularity
pages.text: Amethyst shards compressed into a single violet point. It rings softly when tapped, like a crystal bell, and the sound seems to come from all around. Purple light refracts out of it in all directions.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Amethyst grows in geodes and chimes when struck. Feeding enough shards into the Singularity Compactor, I crushed them into a single ringing point.
